title: NCU Metric-Availability Probe
description: Committed artifact produced by tools/local_labels/probe_ncu_metric_availability.py from a live `ncu --query-metrics` enumeration on the local card. Records, for every target metric named by tools/local_labels/read_ncu_report.py plus the committed metric_registry.json, the exact rolled-up NCU id, type, unit, and availability on this device. Unavailable/renamed/uncatalogued metrics carry a typed `excluded_reason` and NO fabricated value. Quarantined to data/local_labels/.

device.description: Device name reported by NCU's query (e.g. 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti').

ncu_metric_version.description: Normalized NCU release family (e.g. ncu_2026.1.x) parsed from `ncu --version`.

get_L1_Total_Requests_resolved_to.description: The concrete NCU metric id get_L1_Total_Requests resolved to (e.g. l1tex__t_requests.sum), or null when the candidate was not confirmed available.

ncu_type.description: NCU metric type (Counter / Ratio / Throughput / ...). Present iff available.

ncu_unit.description: NCU metric unit (may be empty for unitless counts). Present iff available.

rollup.description: The rollup suffix (max / sum / pct / avg.per_cycle_elapsed / ...), or 'none' for a scalar metric. Present iff available.

excluded_reason.description: Typed reason this metric is not collectable as an NCU counter on this device. Present iff NOT available; never paired with a fabricated value.

base_metric.description: The base metric (portion before the first rollup '.'). Present iff NOT available.

allOf.description: Available metrics carry the NCU-reported type/unit/rollup; excluded metrics MUST NOT (no fabricated value).
